colors.name: Signal Orange
colors.role: Primary canvas - the full-viewport page background that changes on refresh; this is the design system

colors.name: Olive Ink
colors.role: Primary text, headline color, and the only outlined action accent (outlined-button borders, link underlines) - warm dark green-brown that pairs with the orange field without competing chroma

colors.name: Oxblood
colors.role: Alternating surface variation - one of the page colors the background can take on refresh

colors.name: Burnt Sienna
colors.role: Alternating surface variation - secondary warm shade the canvas can adopt

colors.name: Near Black
colors.role: Alternating surface variation - deep cool surface the canvas can adopt, creates the darkest mode of the page

colors.name: Pearl
colors.role: Soft warm highlight - one of the lighter surface variations the canvas can adopt

colors.name: Sage Mist
colors.role: Soft cool surface variation - one of the muted color states the canvas cycles through

colors.name: Carbon
colors.role: Album cover backgrounds, deep text on light surface states

colors.name: Ink
colors.role: Album cover backgrounds and heavy dark surface tone

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.role: Album cover and card backgrounds within the grid

colors.name: Ash
colors.role: Mid-neutral for muted helper text and secondary surface states

colors.name: Paper
colors.role: Album cover backgrounds, text on dark surface states

fonts.name: Helvetica LT Pro
fonts.role: The sole typeface across all text - display, heading, body, button, link. A single weight (400 regular) is used at every scale, which is the most distinctive typographic choice on the site. The whisper-regular giant-size headlines are anti-convention; most poster/editorial sites use 700-900 for display type, and using the book weight at 137px makes the headline feel stamped rather than shouted - authority through stillness.

fonts.name: Helvetica
fonts.role: Helvetica - detected in extracted data but not described by AI

components.name: Display Headline Block
components.role: The page-defining typographic element - site title rendered as a monolithic shape

components.name: Section Subtitle
components.role: Short descriptive line that sits directly under the display headline

components.name: Album Cover Tile
components.role: Unframed square image in the content grid

components.name: Refresh Record Button
components.role: The only interactive control - a small circular record/disc icon that triggers a full page color change

components.name: Rotated Side Label
components.role: Vertical instructional text - tells the user the page mechanic

components.name: Outlined Action Border
components.role: Chromatic border treatment for interactive elements (links, tags, light buttons)

components.name: Body Caption
components.role: Small helper text used in metadata, tags, or footnotes

do: Set display headlines at 137px / line-height 0.79 / letter-spacing -0.05em in Helvetica LT Pro 400 - never bump the weight, the book weight is the signature

Use Olive Ink (#4f503e) for all text and borders regardless of canvas color - the text must always be the same dark warm tone so the changing background feels like a single identity expressing different moods
Let the page canvas fill 100% of the viewport edge-to-edge with no container, no max-width, no margin - full-bleed is non-negotiable
Use 20px as the only spacing unit - vertical rhythm between the headline, subtitle, and grid is always 20px
Keep all radii at 0px - album tiles, buttons, and tags are sharp-cornered; the colored field provides all the softness the page needs
Treat the canvas color as the primary navigation: the user changes the page by changing the background, not by clicking links
Set every text element in a single weight (400) - do not introduce bold, medium, or light variants
doNot: Do not use filled buttons - a solid fill would compete with the canvas color; all actions are outlined borders or pure icons
Do not add card frames, drop shadows, or elevation to album tiles - they sit directly on the canvas with no chrome
Do not introduce a second typeface - the entire site is set in one family at one weight
Do not center body text - copy aligns left, full-bleed, and wraps naturally
Do not use a max-width container - the layout is always edge-to-edge
Do not pair Olive Ink (#4f503e) text with a colored background outside the established palette (oxblood, sienna, near-black, sage, pearl) - the six surface colors are the only valid canvases
Do not add line-height above 1.0 for any size above 21px - the tight leading (0.79-0.80) on display text is what makes the headlines feel like solid shapes
